_comment: The Grey Chapels story (owner 2026-10-12: «the mystery of the Grey Communion», a prologue and 3 story contracts, no deadlines, told by letters and notes; Claude's draft, the owner edits). Steps in order: the step's contract (petition = its letter in contracts/petitions.json) starts at once when the previous one is done; its note (after) is the morning letter once the contract is finished. The last step's note offers choices (reputation changes); the end letter closes the chapter.

after.text: In the drain, among the small bones, a stub of grey candle. Its wax carries the seal of the Grey Communion. Why would the chapel's candles burn down there?

The thing you brought us burned chapel incense in its lantern. Inside the glass we found a prayer slip — a list of names. All of them are our dead, the unclaimed ones the Communion buries without a stone. I do not understand it. I am afraid to.

Under the hound's collar — a key to the crypt. Below the chapel: ledgers in the deacon's hand. The Communion has been feeding the creatures with the unclaimed dead for years, and every page ends the same way: 'it answers from below'.

The digger is dead in the rubble of the crypt. The ledgers are still in your coat. Inspector Crane wants them: with them the Vigil will close the chapel for good. The deacon begs you to burn them: without the chapel, he says, the poor of the Grey Chapels have nothing at all.

choices.text: Give the ledgers to the Iron Vigil
Burn the ledgers for the Communion

end.text: The quarter talks about you now — some with a toast, some behind their hands. Whatever answers from below has gone quiet. For now. (End of the Grey Chapels chapter; the city beyond waits.)
